mapper.select:
SELECT GLUE, SEGMENT, MOTHER_GLUE1, MOTHER_GLUE2, MOTHER_GLUE3, MOTHER_GLUE4, MOTHER_GLUE5, MOTHER_GLUE6, MOTHER_GLUE7, MOTHER_GLUE8, MOTHER_GLUE9 FROM T_GLUE_DECOMPOSE WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
AND GLUE IN #{glueAreaMachine.glue}

SELECT MIX_AREA, MACHINE_CODE, GLUE, MOTHER_GLUE1, MOTHER_GLUE2, MOTHER_GLUE3, MOTHER_GLUE4, MOTHER_GLUE5, MOTHER_GLUE6, MOTHER_GLUE7, MOTHER_GLUE8, MOTHER_GLUE9 FROM T_MACHINE_GLUE_DECOMPOSE t WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
AND (MIX_AREA,MACHINE_CODE,GLUE) IN (#{glueAreaMachine.mixArea},#{glueAreaMachine.machineCode},#{glueAreaMachine.glue})

SELECT GLUE, SEGMENT, MOTHER_GLUE1, MOTHER_GLUE2, MOTHER_GLUE3, MOTHER_GLUE4, MOTHER_GLUE5, MOTHER_GLUE6, MOTHER_GLUE7, MOTHER_GLUE8, MOTHER_GLUE9 FROM T_GLUE_DECOMPOSE WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (MOTHER_GLUE1 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE2 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE3 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE4 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE5 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE6 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE7 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE8 = #{motherGlue} OR MOTHER_GLUE9 = #{motherGlue}) ORDER BY CREATE_TIME desc

select * from ( SELECT r.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE as MACHINE_CODE, r.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AS GLUE, t.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME as SON_GLUE, r.RECIPE_TYPE, r.RECIPE_VERSION_ID, r.PRODUCT_STAGE FROM T_MES_PMT_RECIPE r INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL m on m.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND m.MATERIAL_NAME=r.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AND m.MAJOR_TYPE in ('4','5') INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE_WEIGHT t ON t.DEL_FLAG='0' AND r.RECIPE_ID=t.FATHER_RECIPE_ID INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL m1 on m1.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND m1.MATERIAL_NAME=t.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME AND m1.MAJOR_TYPE in ('4','5') WHERE r.RECIPE_STATE = '1' AND r.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) t order by (case when regexp_like(RECIPE_TYPE,'^[0-9]+$') then RECIPE_TYPE + 0 else 9999999 end) desc, (case when regexp_like(RECIPE_VERSION_ID,'^[0-9]+$') then RECIPE_VERSION_ID + 0 else -1 end)
